name: 外部占用和合同管理 – 集团分类账 IFRS (5YV)
name_en: External Occupancy and Contract Management – Group Ledger IFRS (5YV)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item is only relevant for the Integration with SAP Cloud for Real Estate.

After you group Real Estate Objects (Buildings, Floors, Spaces, Land, Land Areas) in the Group Real Estate Object for Occupancy SAP Fiori app, manage and maintain them within the Manage Occupancy Groups SAP Fiori app.

It enables the functionality to manage lease-out contracts for real estate objects with external customers. It supports the relevant lease-out processes like partner posting, valuation posting, or rent adjustment.

You can use the Contract Management SAP Fiori app to create lease-out contracts. You can easily create new contracts and execute periodic postings for existing contracts.

You can change the customer of an existing contract, as well as run reports of your existing contracts as part of your daily business.

You can create reminder rules for every contract, for example, to check the contract conditions, the contract term, or the renewal options, helping you to save time and effort and free up capacity for more strategic tasks.

Key Process Flow

  • Create a group of real estate objects for external occupancy
  • Create lease-out contract and assign the external occupancy group to the object assignment
  • Manage the lease valuations for the lease-out contract
  • Execute periodic postings

Business Benefits

  • Use single repository for all real estate assets in the entire portfolio independent of back-end system
  • Collect costs by real estate location, supporting financial reporting and location analysis
  • View vacancy/occupancy reporting for each location based on space type
  • See what fixed assets are used to support each enabled object
description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目仅与与 SAP Cloud for Real Estate 集成相关。

在分组要占用的不动产对象 SAP Fiori 应用中对不动产对象（建筑物、楼层、空间、土地、土地范围）进行分组后，在管理占用组 SAP Fiori 应用中管理和维护它们。

它支持通过外部客户管理不动产对象的租出合同的功能。它支持相关租赁流程，例如合作伙伴过账、评估过账或租金调整。

您可以使用合同管理 SAP Fiori 应用创建租出合同。您可以轻松创建新合同并为现有合同执行定期过账。

您可以更改现有合同的客户，并在日常业务中运行现有合同的报表。

您可以为每个合同创建提醒规则，例如，检查合同条件、合同条款或续订选项，帮助您节省时间和工作量，并释放更多战略任务的能力。

关键流程流

  • 为外部占用创建一组不动产对象。
  • 创建租出合同，并将外部占用组分配到对象分配
  • 管理租出合同的租赁评估
  • 执行定期过账

业务优势

  • 独立于后端系统，为整个投资组合中的所有不动产资产使用单一资源库
  • 按不动产位置收集成本，支持财务报告和位置分析
  • 根据空间类型查看每个位置的空缺/占用报告
  • 查看用于支持每个已启用对象的固定资产。
